Filter proteins by group presence

Source: R/Normalization.R
dot-filter_proteins_by_group.Rd

Keeps proteins that have enough non-NA values in at least a minimum number of experimental groups.

Usage

.filter_proteins_by_group(
  data,
  metadata,
  min_reps = NULL,
  min_groups = 1,
  grouping_column = "Condition"
)

Arguments

data

Intensity matrix (proteins x samples)

metadata

Data frame with sample information

min_reps

Minimum replicates with non-NA values per group. If NULL, uses half of the smallest group size.

min_groups

Minimum groups meeting min_reps (default: 1)

grouping_column

Name of grouping column in metadata (default: "Condition")

Value

List with:

  • data: Filtered matrix

  • keep: Logical vector of kept rows

  • summary: Filtering summary
